method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose byte buffers use U8; Blot stores identical values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed backing capacities retained. Sort U32 values are nonnegative and preserve I32 ordering; ports restrict sizes to100000/400000, where exact integer RNG conversion matches every Goose F64 RNG state. Mandelbrot uses explicit ordered F32 in BOTH sources; original F64 remains unavailable. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.
